extracted.rawText:
Full Stack Engineer

Arbital Health is a rapidly growing healthcare technology and actuarial leader that centralizes, measures, and adjudicates value-based care contracts at scale.  We enable payers and providers to design, measure, and execute value-based agreements with greater transparency, efficiency, and financial predictability.
We invest in hiring high potential and humble individuals who thrive in fast-paced environments and can rapidly grow their responsibilities as we continue to accelerate our growth.
 
We were co-founded by Brian Overstreet and Travis May (founder & former CEO of LiveRamp and Datavant, the two biggest data companies of the last 20 years), and are backed by Transformation Capital, Valtruis and other leading investors. In our first 2 years, Arbital Health has established itself as a trusted partner for over 40 payers, providers, and other stakeholders looking to navigate the complexities of risk-based contracting.


We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer that will work across our product stack — from React components to API routes to the SQL queries behind them — owning features end to end, from design through production. You'll work in an AI-native environment -- fluency with AI coding tools isn't just a nice-to-have; it's how we ship fast without sacrificing quality. You will have real ownership early: you will be trusted to take a well-scoped problem and run with it.  This is a strong fit if you care about the craft of building interfaces people actually enjoy using, and you want to go deep on a genuinely hard problem space: making complex healthcare and financial data legible. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and communicate clearly with both engineers and other internal teams, this is the perfect opportunity for you!


What you'll do:
● Turn dense actuarial and financial output into interfaces that are clear at a glance, including data tables, charts, and exports that hold up under real-world data volumes and actuarial scrutiny
● Build customer-facing and internal interfaces in our Next.js and React application — the product our customers use to design and monitor the performance of their value-based care contracts
● Design and implement the API routes that power those features, working with high volumes of complex healthcare data
● Work closely with our Product, Design, and actuarial science teams to bring their models and designs to life in the product
● Write tests, review teammates’ code, and help keep the codebase something the team is glad to work in

What you bring:
● 2-5 years of professional full-stack development experience
● A track record of shipping features to production that real users depend on
● Strong fundamentals in TypeScript, Python, and React — you understand component design, state, and rendering behavior, not just the syntax
● Able to work entrepreneurially: self-motivated, ambitious, and comfortable in a rapidly changing, ambiguous start-up environment
● Prior healthcare experience is a plus
● Startup experience is a plus

Tools we use:
● Python, R, SQL, Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, FastAPI
● Claude, Cursor
● Infrastructure: AWS, Databricks, PostgreSQL, Airflow
● Version Control: GitHub
● Team Planning: Jira, Confluence

Why Join Us?
We are assembling a team of creative, talented visionaries seeking to build a new technology that will change healthcare. You will be able to learn, build, and scale our team and technology in a collaborative, creative culture that values every team member.
 
We Offer:
•  Generous equity grants of ISO stock options
•  We offer an exceptional benefits package with high employer-paid contributions for health, dental, and vision insurance
•  4% 401(k) match
•  Flexible PTO, a weeklong winter shutdown, and 10 holidays each year
•  Occasional travel required - Quarterly team offsites
•  The opportunity to build a critical software platform that accelerates the American healthcare system's transition to value-based care
 
Work Authorization
•  Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for the duration of their employment.
• This position is not eligible for employer-sponsored immigration sponsorship, now or in the future. • Applicants must be able to work in the United States without requiring employer sponsorship.
